offence_note: Possession of stolen property, dangerous driving, escaping custody, obstruction
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed only to the extent of deleting the provision for the probation order which the Crown conceded in this case constituted an illegal sentence.
note: Probation order deleted as illegal; jail and driving prohibition stand.

sentence_quote: for having committed the offence of manslaughter by killing Amy Parkes on March 31, 2014, I sentence you to 12 years in jail. You will be entitled to 31 months' credit for your time served in custody

offence_note: Robbery of gas station clerks; breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: (1) Jail – s. 344 – 2 years 6 months, consecutive - s. 145 – 6 months, concurrent (taking totality into consideration) Minus 1 year 69 days of Remand credit Total: 1 year 111 days
note: Impact of Race and Culture Assessment considered; court did not expressly give it mitigating weight in shown text.

offence_note: Offences not shown; dangerous offender declaration appealed

note: Dangerous offender declaration set aside; new sentencing hearing ordered.

sentence_quote: On October 22, 2001, Mr. La was sentenced to six months incarceration on each count in addition to the four months he had already spent in custody.
note: Six months concurrent plus four months pre-sentence custody at double time equals 14 months overall; wife's sentence not appealed.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing bodily harm and assault with a weapon (nail gun)
sentence_quote: Court will be to impose concurrent terms of imprisonment of 18 months for each count served in the community as a conditional sentence order followed by a term of probation of 12 months.
